primitive.relation: one contract, a chordless vertex-sequence cycle: a MathComp ucycle of host adjacency in which every host edge between two of its vertices joins cyclically consecutive entries (cyclic_chordless, over seq_cyclic_consecutiveb, no distinctness premise); three views differ only in the length bound. GTBase.induced_cycles.chordless_ucycle (no bound: the empty list and the two-vertex cycle of an edge qualify) is Extremal.D2str.induced_cycle by conversion (cyc_edge is seq_cyclic_consecutiveb); chordless_cycle (2 < size c, the same term as 3 <= size c) is GTMisc.X91.x91_induced_cycle (redundant u != v after the edge, Prop consecutiveness) and Packing.XE1.xe1_induced_cycle (redundant x != y before the edge, inline Boolean pair test) by explicit iffs; hole (3 < size c) is Chromatic.X3.x3_hole (three-way conjunction, u != v before the edge, Prop consecutiveness) and Minor.X27.x27_hole (x != y after the edge) by explicit iffs. The distinctness premises are proved redundant from sgraph irreflexivity (sg_edgeNeq), never added; no size, nonempty or uniqueness premise beyond each original is added, so D2str's sizes 0 and 2 stay raw-only. GTMisc.U13.induced_cycle shares the normalized name but is a different contract (an injective map 'I_k -> G whose edges are exactly the modular successor pairs, with its own k = 0, 1, 2 behaviour): deferred-excluded, unchanged, not redirected. Distinct and untouched: U13.has_induced_cycle, the induced-isomorphism copies of cycle_graph n (X49, X60, X29), X115's vertex-set odd induced cycles, X161's bare four-vertex ucycle, X169's clique-tree chordality and the directed chordal_C3; Packing.XE1.xe1_chordal is an unchanged chain here.

raw-unbounded.note: ucycle /\ every host edge between cycle vertices is a cycle edge, no length guard (sizes 0 and 2 included); D2str's peripheral cycle and the geodesic-cycle OPG row are frozen over it.

genuine-at-least-three.note: ucycle, 2 < size c (X91 writes 3 <= size c, the same term) and no chord; the redundant distinctness premise (after the edge in X91, before it in XE1) and X91's Prop consecutiveness are bridged by cyclic_chordless_prop_edge_neq / cyclic_chordless_neq_edge. X91's avoidable-path row and Erdos #81 (through the unchanged chain xe1_chordal) are frozen over them.

hole-at-least-four.note: ucycle, 3 < size c and no chord; X3's three-way conjunction with u != v before the edge and Prop consecutiveness (cyclic_chordless_prop_neq_edge) and X27's x != y after the edge (cyclic_chordless_edge_neq). The X3 / X160 hole-length, constricting and rainbow rows and the X27 / X42 / X220 even-hole rows are frozen over them.

ordinal-map-modular-successor.verdict: distinct representation: an injective ordinal map whose edges are exactly the modular successor pairs, not a vertex sequence
ordinal-map-modular-successor.note: GTMisc.U13.induced_cycle keeps its body unchanged (k = 0 vacuous, k = 1 a loop impossible in a simple graph, k = 2 an edge); its has_induced_cycle wrapper, grounding lemmas, the C8 whole-row snapshot and the separately recorded U13 issue are untouched; a later task may relate it to the sequence views.

upstream_audit.note: MathComp path.v supplies ucycle (cycle && uniq, no lower bound) with rot_ucycle / rev_cycle / cycle_map; coq-graph-theory 0.9.7 has sgraph.ucycle_induced (a ucycle of an induced subgraph is a ucycle of the host) and the induced-subgraph / isomorphism machinery, but no chordless-cycle or hole predicate; GTBase.walks_paths supplies seq_cyclic_consecutive(b) with its reflection, rotation and reversal lemmas and the genuine seq_cycle. The three views are therefore new in GTBase.induced_cycles over ucycle and seq_cyclic_consecutiveb, related to seq_cycle by chordless_cycle_seq_cycle.
